svg.data-episode: A Ship That Decided To Be an Animal

g.data-caption: CINNAMON: “Six storeys of wood-and-tin elephant, standing here since 1881.”
CINNAMON: “You climb a spiral staircase inside her hind leg. My second-favourite of those.”
SOCKS: “Her ribs creak in the sea wind. I patted one. It seemed to appreciate it.”
CINNAMON: “From the howdah on her back: the whole Atlantic. Worth every one of the sixty-five feet.”
SOCKS: “Survived lightning, hurricanes, and developers. The last of those were the worst.”
